summary: Phase 1 PBX management feature: backend (25/25 pytest passed) — extensions/trunks/inbound/outbound/hunt/ivr CRUD, validation, RBAC (anon 401), cascade behaviour (trunk delete → inbound delete, ext delete → hunt_group member removal), secret rotation, Asterisk config rendering (pjsip.conf with [200] endpoints + [trunk-<id>], extensions.conf with [from-internal] + outbound/inbound routes + [ivr-<id>] contexts, voicemail.conf with mailbox lines), config-bundle JSON, per-file text endpoint + 404, apply stub. Frontend (manual playwright): /pbx loads as admin, pbx-admin-page renders, all 6 tabs (extensions/trunks/inbound/outbound/hunt/ivr) and pbx-view-config button present, sidebar 'PBX Admin' link visible under Comms section, extension creation flow worked (created ext 300 with display_name 'QA Frontend'), config preview dialog opens with pjsip.conf default and switches to extensions.conf — both contain expected content.

minor.issue: When the parent trunk is deleted, the cascade in the trunk DELETE handler removes inbound routes that reference that trunk_id — that is correct, but the API silently drops the rows with no audit log; consider surfacing the count of cascaded deletions in the trunk delete response.

Validation rejects missing trunk_id via _validate_pattern flow ordering — pattern is validated FIRST before trunk_id existence check; if pattern is invalid + trunk_id missing the user gets only the pattern error. Minor UX nit.
register=true with empty username writes a [trunk-<id>-reg] block with empty client_uri (sip:@host). Backend should require username if register is enabled.

issues: Tab labels are duplicated by trigger icons + counter — minor visual noise on narrow widths (e.g. 'Hunt groups (0)' wraps awkwardly under 1280px).

action_items: Phase-2 wishlist: trigger AMI/SSH reload on the appliance from /api/pbx/apply (currently stub).
Consider validating trunk username is non-empty when register=true.
Consider returning cascade-delete counts in trunk/extension DELETE responses so the admin sees what was affected.

Frontend nit: after closing the config preview dialog, the extension list briefly shows the empty state before re-fetch settles (cosmetic, data is intact — verified via API the ext exists). Consider not refetching on dialog close, or showing the previous list while loading.
critical_code_review_comments: pbx.py:584 — `\n`.join(ln for ln in lines if ln is not None) — filter drops only None, but the code intentionally appends empty strings (truthy filter). This is fine but slightly inconsistent vs other render functions which use plain join. Document the intent.

pbx.py:553-556 — `auth=trunk-<id>-auth` is conditionally appended only if username set; the immediately-following `outbound_auth=` line is ALWAYS emitted but uses the SAME conditional expression — when username is empty this becomes the literal `outbound_auth=` (empty value), which Asterisk will reject on parse. Either skip the outbound_auth line entirely when username is empty or wrap that branch in the if.

pbx.py:580 — `client_uri=sip:{tr['username']}@{host}` will crash with KeyError if `register=True` and the trunk was created via an older path missing `username` (won't happen with current POST validation, but defensive `.get()` is safer).
pbx.py: secrets are stored in plaintext (required for Asterisk) but list_extensions returns secrets to anyone with admin role — fine but ensure the FE log/screenshot redaction is in place.
PBXAdminPage.jsx is 694 lines — close to the 700-line refactor threshold. Consider splitting each entity dialog into its own component file for maintainability.
Frontend: the extension Voicemail PIN input accepts >4 chars (maxLength=6) but backend doesn't enforce digit-only or length. Wire client-side regex + backend validation.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (UI loads, all data-testids present, ext creation + config preview verified; trunk creation flow not fully exercised in script due to tab-switch oversight in the playwright sequence — but backend trunk creation is covered by pytest)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: ext 200/299/300, trunks TestTrunk + CascadeTrunk, plus inbound/outbound/hg/ivr fixtures. All deleted via test cleanup fixture or post-test curl.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 PBX is solid. When Phase 2 lands (AMI live reload + JsSIP WebRTC softphone), the existing /app/backend/tests/test_iter175_pbx.py covers the management-plane regression. For Phase 2 add: (1) /api/pbx/apply should return applied=true and surface AMI reload result; (2) /api/pbx/registrations should return live=true with user_agent populated; (3) WebRTC handshake from FE softphone to Asterisk over WSS:8089. Note: Asterisk itself is NOT running in this preview pod — config render correctness is the only checkable artifact here.
rca of the issue: N/A — all backend tests pass and frontend renders correctly. The single transient frontend observation (extension list briefly showing 0 after closing config dialog) was a render race — verified via API the data persisted. No fix required.
